prompt: A four-person team edits trip reports in a shared network folder. Every week someone pastes over a colleague’s file and the wording is gone forever. Which capability does version control add that fixes this?
explanation: Version control keeps the project’s full history — who changed what, when, and why — so you can revert to any previous state and compare versions. File locking and nightly backups do not give you per-change history or easy merging of parallel work.

options.text: It records every change as a recoverable snapshot, so any earlier version can be restored and compared
It locks each file so only one person can edit it at a time
It backs up the folder to the cloud once per night
It emails a copy of every file to the whole team after each edit
